Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
The Willow Neuromodulation System has not been evaluated for safety in the MR environment.
It has not been tested for heating or unwanted movement in the MR environment. The safety of the Willow Neuromodulation System in the MR environment is unknown. Performing an MR exam on a person who has this medical device may result in injury or device malfunction.
Patients may be scanned immediately after implantation.
